gt_provenance.details: Source-fit exact-token NAVSIM cache and candidate-specific one-frame PDM; not full official PDMS or real-world safety ground truth.

score_normalization.details: Each challenger was independently scored with the same native; official pair-relative progress normalization remains part of the frozen estimand.

result_existence.details: Primary, replay, mechanical audit, logs, failure attribution and hashes exist; ledgers and summaries replay exactly.

candidate_domain_integrity.details: 168 frozen intent-ineligible challengers across 48 anchors entered oracle aggregation; candidate membership and implementation gate did not use the same domain.

reconstruction.details: All 48 flagged anchors reproduce frozen realized poses bit exactly with maximum absolute error 0.0; the combined boolean failed only because eligibility was not all true.

scope.details: 42 fit groups times 16 anchors; no held-out, NavDream, target, full-PDMS or safety claim is supported.
